title: Security Officer - Aculife Healthcare - Viramgam
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Security Officer
   

  

 Company Name: Aculife Healthcare
   

  

 Location: Viramgam, Gujarat
   

  

 Salary: 4\-7 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Qualification: 5\-10 years of experience
   

  

**Job Description**
 Aculife Healthcare, a leading pharmaceutical company, is seeking an experienced and dedicated Security Officer to join our team in Viramgam, Gujarat. If you have a strong background in security management and a commitment to ensuring a safe environment, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Oversee and manage security operations at our facility.
   

  

 Implement and enforce security policies and procedures.
   

  

 Monitor access control, CCTV systems, and security personnel.
   

  

 Investigate and report security incidents.
   

  

 Collaborate with local authorities when necessary.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Minimum of 5\-10 years of experience in security management.
   

  

 Proven ability to handle security challenges effectively.
   

  

 Excellent communication and leadership skills.
   

  

 Familiarity with security technology and systems.
   

  

 Physical fitness and the ability to work in shifts.
   

  

 Join our team at Aculife Healthcare and play a vital role in maintaining the safety and security of our premises and personnel.
   

  

**FAQs**
 Q: What is the salary range for this position?
   

  

 A: The salary for the Security Officer position ranges from 4\-7 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Q: What qualifications are required for this role?
   

  

 A: We are looking for candidates with a minimum of 5\-10 years of experience in security management.
   

  

 Q: Where is the location of this job?
   

  

 A: This position is based in Viramgam, Gujarat.
   

  

 Q: What does Aculife Healthcare specialize in?
   

  

 A: Aculife Healthcare is a leading pharmaceutical company known for its commitment to quality and safety.
   

  

 Q: How can I apply for this position?
   

  

 A: To apply for this role, please submit your resume and contact information through our online application portal on our website.
